title: Resolution urging Albany to ease senior and disability tax exemption deadline
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature and Governor to pass legislation allowing a rolling application deadline in New York City for the disability homeowner exemption and senior citizen homeowner exemption, rather than the current fixed March 15 cutoff. Both exemptions can reduce property taxes by up to 50% for eligible homeowners earning $58,399 or less annually. The Council argues a rolling deadline would let more eligible seniors and people with disabilities obtain the tax relief.
